findings.evidence:
- Index join inner workers are concurrent: `pkg/executor/join/index_lookup_join.go:197` spawns multiple `go innerWorker.run(...)` (`:209-213`), and each worker builds inner executors via `BuildExecutorForIndexJoin` (`pkg/executor/join/index_lookup_join.go:740-742`).
- This PR makes index-join inner plans support embedded hash joins: `dataReaderBuilder` handles `*physicalop.PhysicalHashJoin` (`pkg/executor/builder.go:5024-5025`) and, critically, builds the non-lookup side via the general builder (`pkg/executor/builder.go:5064`).
- General executor building mutates `StmtCtx.TableIDs/IndexNames` via unsynchronized slice appends, e.g.:
  - `pkg/executor/builder.go:4051` (`buildTableReader`: `sctx.TableIDs = append(...)`)
  - `pkg/executor/builder.go:4711-4712` (`buildIndexLookUpReader`: `sctx.IndexNames/TableIDs = append(...)`)
  - `pkg/executor/builder.go:4885-4899` (`buildIndexMergeReader`: `sctx.IndexNames/TableIDs = append(...)`)
- `StatementContext.TableIDs` and `IndexNames` are plain slices (`pkg/sessionctx/stmtctx/stmtctx.go:339-340`) with no internal synchronization, so concurrent appends are a data race.
findings.fix: When `executorBuilder.stmtCtxLock` is set (dataReaderBuilder/index-join inner workers), wrap all non-atomic `StmtCtx` mutations reachable from concurrent inner builds with `executorBuilder.withStmtCtxLock`, including the `StmtCtx.TableIDs` / `StmtCtx.IndexNames` appends in `buildTableReader`, `buildIndexLookUpReader`, `buildIndexMergeReader` (and audit other direct `StmtCtx` field writes).
findings.impact:
With `tidb_enable_inl_join_inner_multi_pattern=1` and an index join whose inner side contains an embedded `PhysicalHashJoin`, concurrent inner-worker builds can race on `StmtCtx.TableIDs/IndexNames`, leading to:
- potential slice corruption/panic in production,
- flaky behavior and `-race` test failures,
- incorrect statement summary/diagnostic metadata (even when it doesn’t crash).
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked later history up to `upstream/master`: `git log b6af20e5..upstream/master -- pkg/executor/builder.go` shows only `44174cf474` and `319a683e05`, and `git diff b6af20e5..upstream/master -- pkg/executor/builder.go` does not add locking around the `StmtCtx.TableIDs/IndexNames` appends; `pkg/sessionctx/stmtctx/stmtctx.go` has no later changes either.
findings.verify:
- Run race detector on index join paths that can build embedded inner hash joins, e.g. `go test -race ./pkg/executor/join -run TestIndex` and a query-level test enabling `tidb_enable_inl_join_inner_multi_pattern=1` with an embedded inner join under `INL_JOIN`.
- Specifically validate no concurrent writes to `StmtCtx.TableIDs/IndexNames` by running with `-race` while executing an index join where the inner plan contains a `PhysicalHashJoin` and the non-lookup child includes `TableReader`/`IndexLookUpReader`/`IndexMergeReader`.
findings.what: Data race / potential panic: enabling embedded inner-join patterns for index join causes concurrent inner-worker executor building to invoke the general `executorBuilder.build` (for the non-lookup child of an inner `PhysicalHashJoin`), which performs unsynchronized slice appends to shared `StmtCtx.TableIDs/IndexNames`.

subject: planner: support index join for embedded inner-join patterns (#66156)
summary: Found a High-severity concurrency bug: embedded inner-hash-join support makes index-join inner workers build additional executors concurrently, but several `executorBuilder` paths still mutate `StmtCtx.TableIDs/IndexNames` via unsynchronized slice appends, which can race/panic; no fix found up to `upstream/master`.
